rationale: Continuing mixed-acid fermentation on lactate, glucose, and arginine. Lactate is the preferred substrate; arginine provides additional energy and nitrogen via Stickland fermentation. Carbon and nitrogen budgets balance: 32 mmol C in supports 21.45 mmol C for biomass growth at 0.65/h plus 10.5 mmol C in fermentation products. Nitrogen (5 mmol) exceeds requirement (4.55 mmol). Fermentation product mix reflects typical F. prausnitzii metabolism: butyrate as major product, acetate and formate as minor products.
